# AI Forecast Atlas

> A weekly-updated scenario model by Creoox AG of how AI is becoming a commodity: capex, revenue, token prices, compute, energy, market structure and work, quarterly from 2023 to 2035, in eight scenarios. Open data under CC BY 4.0.

History until Q4 2026 comes from dated public sources (see dataset.json, each value with status, period and source). Values after Q4 2026 are scenario paths of a system-dynamics model, not forecasts. A new release is published every Friday at 13:00 Swiss time. Please credit "AI Forecast Atlas by Creoox AG" with the release number.

## Data
- [Latest release summary]({{SITE}}data/latest/release.json): what changed, headline numbers per scenario, early-warning signposts, who gains and loses
- [Starting values with sources]({{SITE}}data/latest/dataset.json): value, status, period, source link, derivation and provenance (quote, further references, how obtained, review date)
- [Methods: explanations, formulas and source notes]({{SITE}}assets/methods.json): every dashboard panel and measure — definition, history method and sources, model formula, drivers, caveats (CC BY 4.0)
- [All scenario paths as one long CSV]({{SITE}}data/latest/series/all.csv): columns scenario, quarter, t, metric, value
- [Measure dictionary]({{SITE}}data/latest/metrics.json): names and units
- [Scenarios and drivers]({{SITE}}data/latest/scenarios.json)
- [Release archive]({{SITE}}data/releases/index.json)
- [X watch]({{SITE}}data/xwatch.json): posts on X the editor is watching, newest first, with post links, credibility and impact labels — signals, not data; they never change the model (each release also lists the week's items)

## API
- [MCP server]({{SITE}}api/mcp.php): Streamable HTTP, read-only tools list_metrics, list_scenarios, list_releases, get_release, get_series, explain_metric, get_sources, get_xwatch, get_signposts, get_impacts
- [OpenAPI description]({{SITE}}openapi.json)

## Optional
- [RSS feed of releases]({{SITE}}feeds/releases.xml)
- [The model as a JavaScript module]({{SITE}}assets/engine.esm.js): createEngine(), applyData(dataset), simulate(scenario)
